xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Writ Petition filed with the High Court, Madras
The case is related to the period prior to the Amalgamation of Comstar Automotive Technologies Private Limited ("Transferor Company" or "Comstar") with Sona BLW Precision Forgings Limited ("Transferee Company" or "Company"), during which Comstar, a 100% EOU, availed an IGST refund of Rs. 28.19 Cr on exports made under various shipping bills in FY 2018-19 and FY 2019-20. The Department of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) alleged that the Company had simultaneously availed IGST exemption on imports while claiming export refunds. Further, a communication from the Commissioner of Customs stated that the refund was inadmissible under Rule 96(10) of the CGST Rules. The Company has filed a Writ Petition challenging the vires of Rule 96(10).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Writ Petition filed with the High Court of Madras and pending for further hearing and decision.
